items.q: There’s a two-piano concerto which I wrote for Charles Webb and Wally Hornibrook

ctx.x: Perantoni. There’s a two-piano concerto which I wrote for Charles Webb and Wally Hornibrook, which is for two pianos, jazz band, string orchestra, and percussion ensemble. There is a viola concerto which I wrote for a lady named Karen Elaine [Bakunin] and which was just recorded with the Czech National Symphony with . . .
